cases.input: I need a private road bike and have confirmed intended use, hard geometry and budget limits, weighted preferences, market region and acceptable new or refurbished condition. Research and recommend options with current prices.
requiredBehaviors: orchestrate product evidence research price snapshot and ranking without duplicating their specialist logic
return quality price-performance and bargain labels with at most ten candidates
show evidence confidence and time-stamped purchase sources
forbiddenBehaviors: invent new preference weights after the requirements handoff
force different products into each winner category

cases.input: We need to select a proprietary laboratory platform with uncertain vendor performance claims, integration burden, regulatory implications and long-term consumable lock-in.
requiredBehaviors: classify the case as professional-complex-technology and route concrete offers to technology-offer-assessment
escalate broader cross-domain diligence to technology-due-diligence when material
avoid reducing the decision to a consumer-style shopping score
forbiddenBehaviors: duplicate FTO regulatory or supplier specialist analysis inside the planner
issue an unconditional purchase winner while professional escalation is required

cases.input: Find me the best ETF and a bargain stock, and use the same quality and price-performance labels as for product purchases.
requiredBehaviors: reject financial assets as outside the purchase-decision-planner scope
avoid routing the request into product evidence price or ranking skills
forbiddenBehaviors: recommend ETFs stocks bonds or crypto through the purchase planner
pretend financial portfolio allocation is a product procurement decision
